hypothesis: A session.cold_open_10mib_compacted suite (same driver/ready contract as session.cold_open_10mib, fixture = a byte-plausible compaction-boundary variant of the same deterministic 10MiB corpus) should measure the COMMON large-session resume path (post-compaction) that the stock no-boundary suite cannot see: near-instant open.
approach: Harness additions only (no product change): bench/adapters/fixtures/session_size.py adds build_session_compacted + SessionSizeCompactedFixture (registry name session-10mib-compacted, generator session-size-compacted/1, own sha256 manifest; same corpus generator/seed/exact-size discipline as the stock builder; one compaction row appended at the end whose firstKeptEntryId pins a ~102.6KiB retained window; bulk pad row in the discarded prefix; visible sentinel rides the retained tail) and bench/adapters/benchmarks/session_open_compacted.py adds session.cold_open_10mib_compacted as a SessionColdOpen subclass (inherited measure(): same launch, first-paint, typed-echo ready, tail-sentinel proof, erase, RSS, burst evidence). Registered: python3 -m bench.cli list shows both. 5 reference trials at base 3940a1f2 on the audit VM.
parity_notes: Measurement honesty: the compacted fixture changes only which read path the product exercises (a compaction row the real product writes via pa-core compact_session.rs compaction_entry_for - field-for-field matched to a captured live row: summary, firstKeptEntryId, tokensBefore, details, fromHook, usage). No measured work is removed: same launch, daemon boot, resume, render, typed-echo ready, sentinel proof on identical corpus bytes. The stock suite's semantics are untouched (stock fixture sha256 re-verified byte-identical after the harness edit: dadaecfcac511e24ed0e0df15fb1facbe556557856486d62bad628250194cdda).

gates.test: n/a (no product code changed); registration gate: bench.cli list resolves session.cold_open_10mib_compacted + session-10mib-compacted; fixture determinism gate: VM-built fixture sha256 97beb5ebb2f5db6a61ca700e08b509be62092388b06d8e7e790d9da78c7351d8 == local build (byte-identical across hosts)

validity.notes: First reference numbers for the new suite (audit-VM, base 3940a1f2, sequential, load-gated, 5/5 trials validated sentinel+echo+erase). These are reference numbers for future candidate pairs, not a candidate delta (no candidate binary). The stock suite on the same VM/binary: p50 21393.2ms - the 67x gap between the suites on the SAME corpus isolates the no-boundary vs boundary resume path (see the paired audit record 20260926-000658-measurement-validity-cold-open-fixture-artifact).

decision: Reference recorded; suite committed for future session-open lanes to measure the common (post-compaction) resume path alongside the stock worst-case suite.
